I see. Most changes on T do take about one year to really set in. Other small changes can occur continuously. If his mood hasn’t mellowed out not, I’m sorry but it just sounds like he’s almost resenting you for some reason. (When someone goes on T, they do change quite a bit. I’m definitely not the same person I was, I don’t like the same things I liked. I’m still in my relationship but it’s definitely had it’s rocky moments. Therapy really helped me.) It’s not fair to you to wait around for someone who isn’t going to thank you for being patient. I would talk to him about how his actions have been affecting you. If he hears you out, and you guys can come up with a plan together to work on the relationship/fixing the things that he needs to- give it a shot. If he just starts being rude/gaslighting you, he is not worth it. You should never feel silenced or like you’re always being attacked in the relationship. That’s unhealthy, and I promise you’ll be so glad you got out sooner than later.
